request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:GUARD

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red smock becomes a ragged near-black charcoal smock with a thin bright violet trim along its torn hem; his skin (face, arms) becomes pallid light ash grey, not blue; he wears a necklace of small pale warm ivory bones; his eyes glow bright violet. Keep the face, hair, bandaged hands, feet, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
